app.name: MeetMemo
app.footer: MeetMemo © 2025 - AI-Powered Meeting Transcription with Speaker Diarization

upload.title: Start Your Meeting Transcription
upload.subtitle: Upload a recording or record live to get AI-powered transcription with speaker identification

recording.title: Record Live Meeting
recording.subtitle: Record audio directly from your microphone
recording.tipText: For best results, use a quality microphone and minimize background noise
recording.notSupported: Your browser does not support audio recording
recording.requiresHttps: Recording requires HTTPS. Please access this page via HTTPS to enable microphone access

recentJobs.title: Recent Meetings
recentJobs.empty: No recent meetings. Upload or record your first meeting to get started!
recentJobs.retentionNotice: Meetings are automatically deleted after 12 hours
recentJobs.deleteModalBody: Are you sure you want to delete this meeting? This action cannot be undone.

processing.title: Processing Your Meeting
processing.subtitle: Our AI is transcribing audio and identifying speakers
processing.etaNotice: This usually takes 2-3 minutes for a 10-minute recording

transcript.title: Meeting Transcript
transcript.placeholder: Transcript will appear here after processing

kanban.moveToSpeakerHint: Move to speaker (keyboard-accessible alternative to dragging)

meetingInfo.title: Meeting Info
meetingInfo.confidenceTitle: Confidence reported by the speech recognition model
meetingInfo.speakerHint: Speaker names are auto-identified by AI when possible. Use "Edit Speakers" to make changes.

editSpeakers.title: Edit Speaker Names
editSpeakers.description: Replace speaker labels with actual names. AI suggestions are automatically applied when available.
editSpeakers.tip: Tip: To add a new speaker, use the ✏️ button on any transcript segment.

editText.title: Edit Transcript Segment
editText.newSpeakerPrompt: Enter new speaker name (e.g., John Smith or SPEAKER_03):
editText.speakerHint: Select an existing speaker or add a new one

editSummary.title: Edit AI Summary
editSummary.description: Edit the AI-generated summary to correct any inaccuracies or add additional details before exporting.

removeSpeaker.title: Remove Speaker
removeSpeaker.description_one: {{speaker}} has {{count}} segment. What should happen to it?
removeSpeaker.description_other: {{speaker}} has {{count}} segments. What should happen to them?

loadingScreen.connectionHint: Please ensure the backend service is running and try refreshing the page.
loadingScreen.backendNotResponding: Backend is not responding. Please check if the service is running.

errors.notFound: The requested resource was not found.
errors.unauthorized: You are not authorized to access this resource.
errors.server: Server error. Please try again later.

errors.moveSegments: Failed to move segments to speaker
